issues.problem: Storage denied or quota exceeded blocks new game; denied getItem crashes library and saves/export panel.
issues.rootCause: Uncaught synchronous getItem/enumeration and initial setItem before assigning live session.
issues.fix: Safe read/enumeration, render fresh in-memory session then attempt persist, continue refusing restart when existing auto backup cannot be written.

issues.problem: An older tab overwrites another tab auto save during advance or pagehide.
issues.fix: Compare raw auto to last observed/written snapshot before implicit persist. Conflict preserves stored raw and leaves in-memory export. Explicit load/restart first backs up actual current raw.
issues.limitations: Synchronous compare/write prevents ordinary stale-tab overwrite, not a transactional lock across exactly simultaneous writers.

issues.problem: Downloading a work refreshes root HTML but not current hashed library JS/CSS. A previously installed unchanged worker may leave offline library blank after release.
issues.rootCause: Per-work download only adds work manifest and root/index HTML; current shell manifest ignored.
issues.fix: Fetch current shell manifest with no-store, validate same-origin scoped relative paths, add full shell with work missing entries, retain other cached works, fail closed on HTTP/manifest/cache errors.
issues.limitations: VM verifies worker message logic. Root/subpath browser update and offline reload are parent integration responsibility.
